tessera-linux.description: Tessera runs real Linux desktop apps on your Android phone, as easily as installing an app. Tap Install to set up Debian 13, then pick from nearly 2,000 Debian apps or 2,800+ Flathub apps and launch them with a tap. Each app opens in its own window, with its own icon and its own card in Recents. There's GPU acceleration for Snapdragon phones, Material You theming that follows your wallpaper and dark mode, a full desktop mode with movable windows, per-app sandboxing and a complete Debian terminal.
